messages.subject: Publication announcement!
parts:
Software codesign between end users and developers to enhance utility for biodiversity conservation

Blair et. al paper out now in BioScience [https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biae097] on the co-design of extensions to Wallace EcoMod for uses in biodiversity conservation.  Many of our team members are coauthors. The paper references our developmental version, which can be installed from GitHub: https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace/tree/biomodelos

Please note: our developmental branch is just that- still in development. We are actively working on making improvements. Please use our GitHub issues page for bug reporting. To use this branch, you will also need to install `changeRangeR` from GitHub, as we are in the process of getting it back on CRAN.

- Bethany Johnson & The Wallace Team
